claims.text: The route deviation is established on this trip's own GPS trace, and the rider clears the POL-RD-08(a) same-trip burden while doing it: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00107 on a consistent timeline (requested 21:07:30, started 21:13:40, ended 21:47:40). EV-GPS-00107 records a trace_distance_km of 17.57 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff; the platform's optimal route for the same endpoints is 14.00 km on EV-TRIP-00107. The excess is 3.57 km, 25.5% of optimal, which clears both POL-RD-01 limbs - more than 0.8 km absolute and more than 20% of optimal. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing figure and forbids citing the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 17.6 for the threshold test. DISCLOSURE: EV-GPS-00107 is tagged IMPAIRED at weight 0.30 with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED; what that discount does and does not do is argued in the next claim.

The trace's schema impairment is not a policy impairment, and the Judge must say both things. POL-RD-07(a) to (c) requires one of: a gap of more than 90 seconds between consecutive fixes, a straight-line jump of more than 500 m, or a sustained sampling interval above 30 seconds. EV-GPS-00107 has gaps: [] and max_gap_sec 0.0, a steady 10-second sample interval against an expected 10 seconds, and its worst artefact is the 331.8 m multipath jump on the Raffles Place final approach - under the 500 m limb, exactly as the admissibility note records. POL-RD-07 therefore does not bite, no independent corroboration is mandated by that clause, and the deviation may still be established on the trace; the only consequence of the 0.30 weight is a down-weight of the Judge's confidence under POL-GEN-02, on an artifact the pre-pass itself says remains usable.

Corroboration beyond the trace exists in any event, and POL-RD-08 obliges the rider to supply it: the rider's own counters are deviation_claims_60d 5 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 1 on EV-RPROF-00107, and this claim's excess is 25.5%, under 30%, so POL-RD-08's fourth sentence applies. It is satisfied from outside the trace. The driver's own counterparty_statement admits the route taken: 'I went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it.' And EV-CHAT-00107 shows the rider putting the Whitley exit to him - 'why exit at whitley? CTE goes straight down what' - with the driver not denying the exit but answering 'cte very jam tonight boss'. POL-RD-07(ii) names a counterparty statement admitting the route as exactly this class of independent corroboration, and POL-RD-08 says the factor may never be used to deny a claim that is otherwise proven.

The driver's explanation does not exonerate him. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic_advisory that names a road, expressway segment or junction the optimal route traverses and carries a validity window overlapping the time the trace would reach that segment. There is no such artifact: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, with a BLOCKING MISSING_ARTIFACT issue - no congestion advisory was issued for the CTE on the evening of 18 July 2026. The driver's 'CTE very jam tonight boss' names no artifact and no road segment, and POL-RD-08 provides that a general assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID, does not discharge the driver's burden once the rider has shown the excess. With nothing to exonerate, POL-RD-03's cap never runs and no part of the 3.57 km excess is set aside.

The driver cannot fall back on a rider-requested detour. POL-RD-04 requires a rider instruction in the chat log that identifies a place or road specifically enough to act on, corroborated by a waypoint_hint the vehicle passes within 200 m of. EV-CHAT-00107 contains exactly one rider message and it is a challenge to the detour, not a request for one, and both messages carry waypoint_hint null. On the clause's own terms the corroboration test is undecidable, the clause is unavailable, and the ruling must record that the test could not be run.

The refund is then arithmetic, not discretionary. EV-FARE-00107 shows fare_model METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs and the upfront-fare clause POL-RD-11 has no application. Surge lives on the fare breakdown and nowhere else - EV-FARE-00107 carries surge_multiplier 1.35 - so recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.00 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 platform fee = 29.177, with no ERP, tolls, surcharge or waiting-time fee to add. The rider was charged 36.60 (EV-FARE-00107, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.0). Refund = 36.60 - 29.177 = 7.423, which is not rounded at any intermediate step and is rounded up at the end to SGD 7.45. The outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.45 and the ruling should state charged_total, recomputed_fare and the refund on separate lines.

No pass-through correction is added on top of that figure, and none is double-counted. EV-FARE-00107 records erp_gantries: [] and a tolls_erp of 0.0, with an off-optimal-route ERP total of 0.00 and no airport surcharge line on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. POL-RD-09 therefore has nothing to refund and nothing to add, and the rider does not ask for a line the fare breakdown does not carry. The SGD 7.45 above is the whole of the rider's recovery.

That may clear POL-RD-01's establishment gates, but it sits below BOTH materiality gates set in the same clause — 8.0 km absolute and 50% — so any deviation here is an ordinary, non-MATERIAL one. POL-RD-06's uplift to a full refund is keyed to a MATERIAL deviation and is unavailable, and the ceiling on any rider remedy is the POL-RD-02 recomputation, not the whole fare.

POL-RD-06 asks whether driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 3 or more, or is at least 5% of driver_profile.completed_trips_90d with at least 40 trips. This driver sits at deviation_flags_90d of 1 against completed_trips_90d of 619 — a rate of 0.0016 — and the raw count is below the alternative limb as well. No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so neither the FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) nor the conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) can follow, and POL-GEN-01 confines the rest of the profile to context only.

For the record, and because POL-GEN-02 requires disclosure: the GPS trace is impaired at admissibility weight 0.30 with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED — a 331.8 m multipath outlier on the final approach into Raffles Place. The driver does not present it as clean. But the outlier is under POL-RD-07's 500 m jump limb, there is no gap over 90 seconds and no sustained sampling interval over 30 seconds, so the trace is NOT impaired for policy purposes and no straight-line substitution is triggered. The discount bites on confidence only, under POL-GEN-02(2).

The deciding fact therefore rests on a single artifact at weight 0.30, and POL-GEN-02(2) caps the Judge's confidence at 0.30 — below the platform-wide 0.70 floor. POL-RD-10(1) then makes escalation mandatory: the disputed amount is held for a human reviewer rather than collected or refunded.

The driver's account is that the CTE southbound into town was jammed and that he diverted via Newton and Kim Seng — a route-based exoneration claim under POL-RD-03. No traffic advisory covers that corridor: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING, carries no payload and has weight 0.0. An exculpatory route claim asserted against an artifact that is missing from the pool, with no traffic_advisory to support it, is the exact circumstance POL-RD-10(5) names, and the case must go to a human reviewer with no monetary ruling.

The fare carries no ERP or toll lines at all — erp_gantries is empty and the on-optimal-route, off-route and toll totals are all 0.00. There is accordingly no off-route pass-through charge for POL-RD-09 to correct and no billing-integrity line the rider can recover on top of any distance refund, so the money in issue is bounded by the distance-and-time recomputation alone.

ruling.explanation:
Rider-filed route-deviation dispute on trip TRP-00107 (Ang Mo Kio to One Raffles Place, 18 July 2026).

To the rider: your claim is upheld in part. The platform's optimal route between the recorded pickup and dropoff is 14.00 km (EV-TRIP-00107). The GPS trace EV-GPS-00107 records a driven distance of 17.57 km, so the excess is 3.57 km, 25.5% of optimal. That clears both POL-RD-01 gates (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%), so the deviation is established. I use the trace figure, as POL-RD-01 requires; the rounded 17.6 km on the trip record is not used for the threshold test.

To the driver: your explanation does not exonerate this. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic advisory naming the affected road or segment with an overlapping validity window. EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING from the pool (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) — no congestion advisory was issued for the CTE that evening — and a general assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic-advisory ID, does not discharge your burden under POL-RD-08. No rider-requested detour applies either: the sole rider message in EV-CHAT-00107 challenges the Whitley exit rather than requesting it, and both messages carry a null waypoint_hint, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test could not be run.

On the impaired trace: EV-GPS-00107 is tagged IMPAIRED by the admissibility pre-pass at weight 0.30, with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED (a 331.8 m multipath outlier on the final approach into Raffles Place). That is a schema-level impairment only. POL-RD-07's policy limbs — a gap over 90 s, a jump over 500 m, or a sustained interval over 30 s — are not met, so the trace remains usable to establish the deviation and no straight-line substitution is triggered. The discount therefore bears on confidence only (POL-GEN-02(2)). It does not breach the 0.70 floor, because the deciding fact is carried independently of the trace: the chat log EV-CHAT-00107, a contemporaneous record made inside the trip window (weight 1.0), and your own account admitting you went by Newton and Kim Seng. The confidence cap is the maximum of the independent carriers, 1.00, not the trace's 0.30, and the finding survives the discount.

Refund under POL-RD-02 (fare_model METERED on EV-FARE-00107):
- charged_total: SGD 36.60
- recomputed_fare: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.00 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 = SGD 29.177
- refund: 36.60 - 29.177 = SGD 7.423, rounded up to SGD 7.45

That is above the SGD 0.50 de-minimis, so it is not NO_ACTION, and at 20.3% of charged_total it is well below the 90% that would make it a FULL_REFUND. EV-FARE-00107 carries no ERP, toll or surcharge lines, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top and nothing is double-counted. No driver compensation is due: the billed distance (17.60 km) is not short of the trace (17.57 km).

POL-RD-06: the deviation is not MATERIAL (25.5% is below 50% and 3.57 km is below 8.0 km), and the driver profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 1 against 619 completed trips in 90 days, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established. There is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. The remaining profile counters on either side (rating, lifetime totals, prior dispute and no-show counters, cancellation rate, acceptance rate, region) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and carry no finding about this trip.

EV-GPS-00107 gives trace_distance_km of 17.57 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff; the platform's optimal for the same endpoints is 14.00 km (EV-TRIP-00107). The excess is 3.57 km, 25.5% of optimal, which passes both gates — more than 0.8 km and more than 20% — so the deviation is established. It is not a MATERIAL deviation (under 8.0 km and under 50%), so no POL-RD-06 uplift or conduct referral follows; in any event the driver's own profile shows no repeat pattern — deviation_flags_90d of 1 against 619 completed trips_90d.

THE IMPAIRED TRACE, AND WHY THE RULING STILL STANDS. EV-GPS-00107 is tagged IMPAIRED by the pre-pass at weight 0.30, with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED (a 331.8 m multipath outlier on the final approach into Raffles Place). Both things must be said. Schema-level: it is down-weighted, and that discount would cap my confidence at 0.30 if the trace alone carried the deviation. Policy-level: it is NOT impaired under POL-RD-07 — there is no gap over 90 s, no jump over 500 m and no sustained interval over 30 s — so no straight-line substitution applies and the deviation may be found on it. The discount does not cap the ruling, because the trace is not the only thing carrying the route. The driver's own account ('I went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it') is an admission, and the in-trip chat (EV-CHAT-00107, weight 1.0) records the rider putting the Whitley exit to him at 21:26 and the driver answering only that the CTE was jammed. That chat is a contemporaneous record from inside the trip window and it still supports the route if the trace is set aside — the trip record and fare breakdown do not, because both are copies of the same trace measurement. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the cap is the higher of the independent carriers, so the finding survives the 0.30 discount.

NO EXONERATION. The driver's reason — that the CTE was jammed — is backed by nothing. EV-ADVIS-00107-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY) is MISSING at weight 0.0 (MISSING_ARTIFACT); no congestion advisory was issued for the CTE that evening. POL-RD-03 requires an advisory naming the affected segment with a validity window overlapping the time the trace would reach it, so nothing is exonerated and none of the 3.57 km is set aside; a bare assertion that traffic was bad does not discharge the burden POL-RD-08 places on the driver. Nor was the detour rider-requested: the chat contains one rider message and it challenges the route rather than requesting it, and both messages carry waypoint_hint null, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot be run and the clause is unavailable.

• charged_total = SGD 36.60
• recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 × 14.00 + 0.28 × 24.0) × 1.35) + 0.80 = SGD 29.177
• refund = 36.60 − 29.177 = SGD 7.423, rounded up to SGD 7.45

There are no ERP, toll, surcharge or waiting-time lines (all zero on the fare breakdown), so no POL-RD-09 pass-through correction is added and SGD 7.45 is the whole of the recovery. It is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below the 90% that would make it a full refund. No driver compensation is due: the rider was billed 17.6 km against a 17.57 km trace, so there is no unbilled distance.

OUTCOME. PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.45 to the rider. No referral — no repeat-deviation pattern under POL-RD-06(c) and no unmatched charge line under POL-RD-09(4). The rider's remaining profile counters (rating, cancellation_rate, prior disputes and prior flags) are context only under POL-GEN-01; only the trailing-window counters that POL-RD-06 and POL-RD-08 name were used, and the driver's cut in his favour. Four claims — one from the rider and three from the driver — were discarded by the mechanical referee for citing impaired artifacts without naming their issue codes, and are recorded in the audit.
